$comment: Golden contract for the UI ↔ firmware command boundary. CLAUDE.md Rule 9: every WS command name a doc or UI module invokes must appear in firmware/src/commands/commands.c COMMAND_REGISTRY[] before commit. This golden enumerates the UI's required command surface so the eval.sh can guarantee no UI-invoked command becomes a vapor reference.
extraction_method: grep -oE 'wsSend\\(\\s*\\{\\s*command\\s*:\\s*["'][a-z_]+["']' ui/control_panel.js — every match's command name must exist in the registry.
$open_items: P-34: UI invokes wifi_scan but firmware has no handler (filed in PHASE_2_PREREQUISITES.md).
P-35: UI invokes fs_upload but firmware has no handler (filed in PHASE_2_PREREQUISITES.md).
Both are visible in the registry mismatch — eval.sh will fail-loud on them when the gates run.
